description: After the user says they've submitted an ncrypted_request, collect and deliver the value. destination 'vercel_env' or 'dotenv' writes it without showing it to you (preferred). 'return' gives you the value; use it only when you must use it directly, and never repeat it. Returns status 'pending' if the user hasn't answered within wait_seconds; call again later.

cwd.description: Project directory containing .vercel/project.json. Default: the server's working directory.

key.description: Variable name (required for vercel_env and dotenv).

path.description: dotenv only: path to the .env file. Default ./.env

project.description: Vercel project name or id. Default: the project linked in cwd's .vercel/project.json.

team.description: Vercel team id (team_...) or slug. Default: the linked project's team.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the user. Default 60.

name: ncrypted_request_fulfill
title: Receive a requested secret
